## Grade breakdown

- Class participation (incl. quizzes) — **20%**
- 8 Reading Responses — **40%**
- Rhythm of Life — **20%**
- Final Exam — **20%**

Reading Response grading: **2** Pass · **1** Poor pass · **0** Fail. Term average must be 2. **Late responses are not accepted.** Each response ends with a *Quote of the Day*.

Formatting for written work: double-spaced, page numbers, 1" margins, name + due date + title on page 1.
